findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_market_events, check_policy · Private data: get_vault, get_vault_risk_breakdown, get_ondo_asset, get_ondo_asset_data, get_native_asset_assessment, get_native_asset_financials, get_protocol_info, get_curator_info, get_market_overview, check_policy · Public sink: list_markets, get_market, check_policy.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_market_events, check_policy · Private data: get_vault, get_vault_risk_breakdown, get_ondo_asset, get_ondo_asset_data, get_native_asset_assessment, get_native_asset_financials, get_protocol_info, get_curator_info, get_market_overview, check_policy · Public sink: list_markets, get_market, check_policy

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
